plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git and forge workflow: atomic Conventional Commits, an issue-to-pull-request ship skill, and guardrail hooks (no git -C, no commits/pushes on main, origin only, no AI attribution).

plugins.name: docker
plugins.description: Manage Docker containers and Docker Compose services with automatic devcontainer detection and safety constraints. Includes a container skill (docker CLI) and a compose skill (docker compose).

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Interact with Obsidian vaults via the Obsidian CLI: create, read, search, edit, and restructure notes following the PARA method.

plugins.name: presentation-drafter
plugins.description: Draft structured presentation outlines using the SCR framework and Patrick Winston's How to Speak principles.

plugins.name: presentation-designer

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Colorful statusline showing model, cwd, git branch/dirty state, context-window usage bar, and output style.
